verdict.rationale: YPOG is a law and tax advisory firm, not a software or automation platform, so letting users schedule recurring jobs or workflows is the wrong axis for this kind of product. Its mentions of 'digital workflows' and the software-supported YSolutions filing service describe how the firm delivers its own services. Nothing shows a user-facing scheduling capability, so the exception that would make the axis apply is not triggered.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
